purpose: Teach: 演歌/林檎/車庫/国宝/大西洋/スリル/毛皮/ビーフ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお父さん、演歌好きだろ?
lines.style: Casual, testing question tossed out. Light challenge in the tone — she's probing for a reaction. Slight uptick at the end like she's daring him to dodge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食の林檎残してたな、桜
lines.en: You left your apple at lunch, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet counter-volley. Not accusatory — almost amused. Calm delivery, eye contact. The pause before her name suggests he's been watching her, noticed this detail.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、二台分の車庫あるんだろ?
lines.en: Your place has a two-car garage, doesn't it?
lines.style: Same probing rhythm as the first line. Faster than a genuine question — she's listing things she's noticed about him. Challenge underneath the casual tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で国宝の単元やったろ?桜
lines.en: You covered the national treasures unit in social studies, yeah?
lines.style: Matching her rhythm and pace now. Equally casual but sharper — he's clearly been watching her too. Each fact lands with quiet precision. Sakura's name at the end is a soft anchor.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、地理で大西洋の航路やったろ?
lines.en: You studied the Atlantic trade routes in geography, right?
lines.style: Maintaining the same pattern — rapid-fire, matter-of-fact delivery. No warmth, no meanness. Just facts accumulated over time. Slight lift in energy as the specificity increases.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、絶叫マシンのスリル好きだろ?桜
lines.en: You love the adrenaline rush on roller coasters, don't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Pushing deeper now. Still conversational but the observations are getting more personal. Name-drop at the end carries weight — he's showing he's been paying attention to the details that matter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、毛皮反対派なんだろ?
lines.style: A real one this time — closer to a genuine conviction she holds. Shorter, sharper. Less teasing, more recognition of something actual about her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食のビーフカレー好きだろ?桜
lines.en: You like the beef curry at lunch, right, Sakura.
lines.style: Small, warm observation. Softer landing than the others — he's circling back to something simple and genuine. The name at the end feels intimate, almost tender. Close proximity implied.
